rules.headings: font-family: 'Chivo', sans-serif; tracking-tight, no generic sans for headings.
rules.body: font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; leading-relaxed for optimal reading.

colors.strategy: Swiss Brutalism / Functional - Color is used strictly for hierarchy and action. No gradients. No soft shadows.

surface_strategy.name: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look)
surface_strategy.description: Expose the skeleton. Make the grid visible for this data-heavy admin tool.
implementation: Use sharp edges (no border-radius or max 4px for form elements).
Use border-collapse style layouts for tables and major sections.
No drop shadows. Rely on 1px solid borders for separation.
Header must be a Solid Background (#FFFFFF) with a hard 1px bottom border.

layouts.spacing: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6) for data density, but generous internal padding (p-6) for forms and modal containers.
page_structure: 2. Main container aligned left or center with max-w-7xl.
3. Action bar above tables for mass operations (Generate, Delete, Print).

components.ui_library: Shadcn UI (Customized for JS, not TSX)

specific_rules.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm), high contrast. Primary action is #002FA7.
specific_rules.tables: Dense rows, 1px visible borders, hover state highlights row with a very light blue (#F0F4FF).
specific_rules.forms: Inputs must have sharp borders, distinct focus states (ring-2 ring-[#002FA7] ring-offset-0), left-aligned labels.
specific_rules.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for 'Ручная правка' (Manual edit). Must have an explicit close button and stark white background.
specific_rules.tabs: Flat tabs with a bold bottom border for the active state. No pill-shaped backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep stroke-width at 1.5 or 2 for high legibility.
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimalist. Focus on rapid micro-interactions. Add smooth opacity/transform on modals. No bouncy animations.
visual_enhancers.loading: Use an indeterminate linear progress bar at the top of the table/page during Excel processing.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG standards. No grey-on-grey.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a high-contrast focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7]).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="upload-excel-btn"`).

print_styles.instructions: Admin needs to print directly. Add `@media print` CSS rules in index.css to hide the navigation, action buttons, and sidebar. Ensure only the document preview/content is printed with zero margins.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Make it crisp, professional, and 'Swiss-designed'.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Add transitions only for specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container text (no `.App { text-align: center; }`). Keep data left-aligned.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use the specified icon library (lucide-react).
Use 2-3x more internal spacing in forms/cards than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., `hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white`).
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Договоры успешно сформированы').
All components should be written in standard modern JavaScript (.js), avoiding TypeScript types.
Ensure the application strictly follows Russian language copy for all UI elements.
